examples.en: Amanda launched into an authoritative disquisition about contracts.
examples.zh: 阿曼达开始了一番对合同的权威解释。

examples.en: Quite aside from her tiredness, Amanda seemed unnaturally abstracted.
examples.zh: 除了疲惫不堪，阿曼达看上去还一反常态地心不在焉。

examples.en: This was without doubt the most interesting situation that Amanda had ever found herself in.
examples.zh: 这无疑是阿曼达遇到过的最有趣的情况。
